frequency_question: What proportion of major announced tariff actions are implemented as originally scheduled rather than averted by negotiation or delay within the implementation window?
membership_rule: Includes formal announcements of substantial unilateral tariffs on specific trading partners with a defined implementation date within 3-6 months. Excludes routine anti-dumping duties or minor administrative trade adjustments.
window: 110 days from announcement to scheduled implementation

cases.name: Section 232 Steel and Aluminum Tariffs (various partners)
Threatened Tariffs on Mexico over immigration
Tariffs on European Union aircraft and goods (Boeing-Airbus dispute)
Threatened 100% Tariffs on French Wine (digital services tax dispute)

coverage_note: 5 named major bilateral tariff escalation events with short implementation windows; representative of general historical frequency.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively capture every minor tariff adjustment, but focuses on high-level bilateral trade pressure tactics.
validity_reason: Trade policy patterns under executive tariff authorities remain structurally consistent across recent presidential administrations.
